angle: Unlike other backprop treatments that train a network numerically, this one derives the last-layer weight sensitivity as a three-ratio chain-rule product on a one-neuron-per-layer model, then extends it to indexed multi-neuron paths with summed influences.
angle_detail: Start with [02:27]–[04:07] because that stretch splits the last-weight sensitivity into three ratios before any formulas are evaluated. Note the notation clash: superscripts mark layers while subscripts mark neurons, with separate symbols for the weighted sum, the activation, and the single-example cost, so copy the index order carefully. Watch [06:43]–[09:13] for the multi-path extension where one earlier activation feeds several outputs, and treat the cost-averaging remarks as a sketch rather than a training-loop procedure.
